sections.title: Reklaam, mis on suunatud lastele
sections.body: Advertising directed at children: must not create feelings of inferiority, exploit trust, include frightening elements or direct purchase appeals.

sections.title: Reklaamimise keeld õppeasutustes
sections.body: Advertising prohibited in educational facilities during instructional time (exceptions for public health messaging, educational events).

sections.title: Tubakatoote reklaami keeld
sections.body: Tobacco advertising prohibited. Limited exceptions for trade publications.

sections.title: Narkootiliste ja psühhotroopsete ainete reklaami keeld
sections.body: Narcotic/psychotropic substances: complete prohibition except medicinal use by qualified professionals.

sections.title: Relvade ja laskemoona reklaam
sections.body: Firearms/ammunition: restricted to sales locations, trade shows, specialised publications.

sections.title: Hasartmängu reklaam
sections.body: Gambling advertising requires valid operating licence. Specific restrictions on toto, skill games, lotteries.

sections.title: Tervishoiuteenuse reklaam
sections.body: Healthcare services: comprehensive ban including artificial reproduction services.

sections.title: Alkoholi reklaam
sections.body: Alcohol advertising: mandatory health warning 'Tähelepanu! Tegemist on alkoholiga...'; prohibition on depicting consumption/social success; banned from schools, sports facilities, youth venues, broadcast media 7am-10pm.

sections.title: Järelevalve
sections.body: Supervisory authority: Consumer Protection and Technical Inspection Authority (TTJA) under administrative law procedures.

sections.title: Sunniraha
sections.body: Fines up to €400,000 for organisations; coercive measures under Administrative Enforcement Act.
